slides.title: Ellipsis and substitution
slides.subtitle: so, not, do so, one / ones
goals: Use **so / not** after *think, hope, suppose, afraid*.

head: Device
Example
rows: She wanted to leave, and she **did so** at once.
Will it rain? — I hope **not**. / I think **so**.
He said he'd help, but he **didn't**.
I didn't want to go, but I had **to**.

items.q: Do you think it will work? — I suppose ___.
These shoes are too small. Do you have bigger ___?
